item.title: Flash Flood Warning Survival: The Essential Guide You Need Now
item.description:
Flash Flood Warning Survival: The Essential Guide You Need Now

What if the loudest alarm your phone ever screeches isn’t a tornado siren — but a flash flood warning? This weekend, that exact alert tore through phones from Dallas to St. Tammany Parish, as severe storms parked over Central Texas, the Gulf Coast, and the Plains.

Quick Summary

  • A Flash Flood Warning means flooding is happening or about to happen — act immediately.
  • In 2024, the National Weather Service issued over 90 flash flood emergencies, with 34 tied to Hurricane Helene alone.
  • The Austin–San Antonio–Dallas corridor is nicknamed “Flash Flood Alley” for a reason.
  • Just one foot of moving water can carry away most vehicles.

If you scrolled past your last weather alert, this article is the wake-up call. Flash floods kill more Americans in a typical year than hurricanes or tornadoes — and the warnings have been firing across multiple states in the past 72 hours.

item.title: Tornado St. Louis: Nearly a Year Later, Recovery Stalls as New Warnings Sound
item.description:
Tornado St. Louis: Nearly a Year Later, Recovery Stalls as New Warnings Sound

Key Takeaways:

  • The May 16, 2025 EF-3 tornado killed 5 people, damaged over 5,000 structures, and caused an estimated $1.6 billion in damage
  • Nearly 11 months later, many neighborhoods remain littered with broken windows, blue tarps, and untouched homes
  • New tornado watches and warnings were issued for the St. Louis area on April 15–16, 2026, renewing fears
  • New documents reveal why the cleanup has been so painfully slow
  • Federal aid has been requested but remains pending

As tornado watches flash across the St. Louis region once again this week, residents are experiencing a grim sense of déjà vu. On the evening of April 15, 2026, KMOV issued a First Alert Weather Day with a tornado watch for parts of the area through midnight. By Wednesday night, tornado warnings were issued for Franklin County and parts of Gasconade and Crawford County.

item.title: Flood Watch Alerts Sweep the U.S.: Essential Guide to Staying Safe This Spring
item.description:
From the shores of Hawaii to the streets of Southeast Michigan, flood watch alerts have dominated weather headlines across the United States in mid-April 2026. Multiple states are bracing for significant rainfall, with some regions already reporting flooding, hail, and wind damage. If you think flood season only affects coastal areas or river towns, think again — these alerts are hitting urban centers, suburbs, and rural communities alike.
